Body.Content:
AKS is introducing security dashboard in the portal. You can now have full visibility over the vulnerabilities of runtime and host in your AKS cluster. Defender for Cloud blade in the Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) portal offers a simplified and streamlined experience for the resource owner or a cluster administrator, in preview. This capability is unique to Microsoft as it provides granular visibility into the container posture assessments (vulnerability assessment, compliance, security best practices, CVE remediation) and offers actionable security insights at a cluster level, without the cluster admin having to leave the AKS portal. 

 

Learn more.
